5170-6132-8249-8292.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Massacre Girl triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Massacre Girl trigger.
Resolve the Massacre Girl trigger, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

3139-5660-6769-8095.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3139-5660-6769-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
3139-5660-6769-8095.description:
Cast The Great Henge by paying {G}{G}. 
When The Great Henge enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing The Great Henge, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning The Great Henge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

1283-1651-4365-6441-8276.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Hive by paying {5} and tapping it, creating four 1/1 Wasp artifact creature tokens due to Mondrak and Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate Clock of Omens twice by tapping the Wasps, untapping Chromatic Orrery and The Hive.
Repeat.
1283-1651-4365-6441-8276.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is at least level 2 and is level 3

5078-5849-8176.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} due to Fortune Teller's Talent.
Repeat.

2292-4186-8181.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature, causing you to scry 1
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

586-864-2267-3125-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2267-3125-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Tormod.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

uses.n: Emeritus of Truce // Swords to Plowshares

4-1170-7577.easyPrerequisites: An opponent controls as many or more creatures as you do.
4-1170-7577.description:
Cast Swords to Plowshares using the convoke ability from Hoarding Broodlord by tapping Emeritus of Truce.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emeritus of Truce, which enters prepared.
Resolve Swords to Plowshares.
Repeat.

2021-2060-4565-5902.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

2092-3147-4954.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has at least 7 power.
2092-3147-4954.description:
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding two mana.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping Azorius Chancery and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and if you control lands that can produce {R} and {G}, use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-3699-7297.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control a creature token.
3259-3699-7297.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Cadira, triggering Breath of Fury and Cadira.
Resolve the Cadira trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

647-1368-4289-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
647-1368-4289-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-3192-6972.easyPrerequisites: The number of red creatures you control excluding Ulasht plus the number of green creatures you control excluding Ulasht is at least X.
413-3192-6972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ulasht.
When Ulasht dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Ulasht enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

4823-5195-7431.description:
Cast Daydream by paying {W}, targeting Timeless Witness
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Timeless Witness
When Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Daydream to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

774-907-5478.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it triggers.
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Selesnya Sanctuary's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

4785-5921-5970-7014.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of North Pole Patrol.
Activate one of the North Pole Patrol tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other North Pole Patrol token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1669-5795-6871-6879.description:
Cast Barkform Harvester by paying {3}.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Barkform Harvester.
When Barkform Harvester dies, Haru triggers, returning Barkform Harvester from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-851-3789-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using The Blackstaff of Waterdeep.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-6872--5.easyPrerequisites: One of the persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
4050-6872--5.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a persist creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Long Feng trigger.
Resolve the Long Feng trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other persist creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1766-1987-2468-2751.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Ghostly Flicker without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Thran Dynamo and Strionic Resonator.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-5043-5078-5741.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Alela triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Faerie, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Repeat.

4404-4702.easyPrerequisites: Splinter Twin attached to Corridor Monitor.
4404-4702.description:
Activate Corridor Monitor by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
When the token Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping the nontoken Corridor Monitor.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-617-5034.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Sol Ring.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Voltaic Key.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Sol Ring.
Repeat.

465-618-2921.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token.
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

372-961-3277.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Against All Odds exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-961-3277.description:
Cast Against All Odds by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Izzet Chronarch and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Izzet Chronarch trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Against All Odds from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Against All Odds.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Izzet Chronarch and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2061-2556-4872.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Time Warp each turn.
2061-2556-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall.
When the Mnemonic Wall token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1339-2921-5572.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2921-5572.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Dragon Appeasement triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

985-2363-5220.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Hangarback Walker enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Hangarback Walker on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1809-4050-5117.description:
Cast Undying Malice by paying {B}, targeting Returned Pastcaller.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Returned Pastcaller, adding {B}.
When Returned Pastcaller dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Returned Pastcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Undying Malice from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1651-3094-3946-5228.notablePrerequisites: Descent into Avernus has at least two descent counters on it.
1651-3094-3946-5228.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Glacial Chasm and Descent into Avernus each trigger.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Descent into Avernus' ability.
Resolve the copy of Descent into Avernus' ability, putting two descent counters on it, then causing each player to create a number of Treasure tokens equal to the number of descent counters on it, and then deal that much damage to each opponent.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasures, untapping Lithoform Engine.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat from step 2.

2011-2411-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Lathril and Najeela do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Lathril.
Lathril has a power of at least six.
2011-2411-4050.description:
Deal combat damage to a player with Lathril.
Lathril triggers, creating at least six 1/1 Elf Warrior tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing five Elf Warrior tokens, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
